name: Chapter
plain: One round of the match. Win two Chapters to win the match.
advanced: Both players can Pass; when both have passed, Realm Score decides the Chapter.

name: Pass
plain: Stop playing for this Chapter and save your cards for later.
advanced: You cannot act again that Chapter after passing.

name: Heart
plain: Your main life total. If it reaches 0, you lose immediately.
advanced: Heart damage persists across Chapters; healing can raise it to 30.

name: Chapter Seal
plain: Win a Chapter to earn a Seal. Two Seals wins the match.
advanced: Tied Chapters award no Seal in the first ruleset.

name: Wonder
plain: Build an amazing magical realm. Reach 10 Wonder to win immediately.
advanced: Wonder rewards deliberate engines and some recipe/landmark cards.

name: Aether
plain: Magic points used to play cards. It refills on your turn.
advanced: The cap grows during a Chapter so bigger cards arrive later.

name: Attunement
plain: The elements your shaped world can use.
advanced: A dual-element card needs both elements represented by terrain you control.

name: Realm Score
plain: How strong your world is this Chapter. Higher score wins when both players Pass.
advanced: Graybox formula: creature Power + landmark Presence + one per shaped/special tile.

name: Frozen

advanced: Combines with another elemental state to discover special terrain.
